**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

- **Rule:** MFN — most-favoured-nation obligations burdening Customer
- **Status:** Compliant at the **preferred** position
- **Key paragraphs:** p0001 (Section 1, Kubient Services), p0023 (Section 5, Fees and Payment)

**Basis:** Searches for "most favoured/favored", "no less favourable", and "favorable", plus a full read of the single-section agreement, returned no MFN, best-terms, or price-matching language. Section 5 (revenue share, with commercials pushed to Exhibits) contains no benchmarking obligation on AP. Section 1 goes the other way, expressly disclaiming exclusivity and preserving AP's right to offer Inventory via other agents or to third parties.

**Notes for the file:** There is likewise no Vendor-granted MFN in AP's favour — welcome but not required by the playbook, so not flagged. One residual point worth tracking commercially rather than as a deviation: because fee and revenue-share terms are set in the Exhibits, any MFN or best-terms language would most plausibly surface there; the Exhibits should be checked against this rule when they are provided.
